**Smash Mouth – the band that sings “Hey now you’re an all‑star” – is currently signed to **Cleopatra Records** (their most recent label deal, announced in late 2024).  

Historically they were best known as an Interscope/Universal record‑label act, with their 1999/2000 hits, including “All Star,” released on Interscope (and the *Shrek* soundtrack version of the song via DreamWorks Records, distributed by Interscope).  They later had releases on 429 Records and, more recently, on Cleopatra.
